title: Alice Cooper Announces New SiriusXM Show During Exclusive Front Row with Stevie Van Zandt
summary: The Front Row special aired live on Little Steven’s Underground Garage from SiriusXM’s New York City studios.
body_markdown:
During his exclusive[SiriusXM Front Row](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/town-hall) hosted by[Stevie Van Zandt](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/steven-van-zandt) ,[Alice Cooper](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/alice-cooper) discussed his new autobiography, *Devil On My Shoulder* , and announced *Alice in Underland* , a new weekly SiriusXM show he’ll host in[Little Steven’s Underground Garage (Ch. 21)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/underground-garage) .


[Maximum rock & soul The Beatles, The Rolling Stones, Ramones & more Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogAliceInUnderlandUndergroundGarage)


The Front Row special aired live in Little Steven’s Underground Garage from SiriusXM’s New York City studios on Tuesday, October 6, in front of a live audience.


Catch encores of the Front Row throughout the week in Little Steven’s Underground Garage, or listen anytime on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogAliceInUnderlandUndergroundGarage) .


### Alice Cooper Launches *Alice in Underland*


Each week, Cooper will dig into Little Steven’s Underground Garage’s expansive playlist, add some of his own selections, and share personal stories from more than five decades at the center of rock and roll.


“Longtime listener, first time DJ!” Cooper said. “Little Steven’s Underground Garage has been locked into my presets for years, and I look forward to being a part of the gang in the garage.”


Cooper added that listeners can expect “tales, tall and not so tall,” along with “some of the best music ever.”


**Debut:** Saturday, October 10 at 4pm ET
**Replay:** Sunday, October 11 at 9pm ET
**Channel:** Little Steven’s Underground Garage
**On Demand:** Available anytime on the SiriusXM app after the premiere
